description: This file defines a ToastService class used for displaying toast notifications in a Blazor application. It includes enum definitions for toast levels, event handling for showing and hiding toasts, and uses a Timer to manage the display duration.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: Service class for managing toast notifications, including showing toasts with different levels and automatically hiding them after a timeout.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message with a specified level and starts the countdown to hide it.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Initializes or resets the countdown timer for hiding the toast.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Creates and configures the Timer object if not already initialized.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler for the timer's elapsed event; triggers hiding of the toast.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the Timer resource when the service is disposed.
